result.question: What is the old prophet's answer to the man of God?

readings.answer: That he too is a prophet and that an angel, by the word of the LORD, told him to bring the man back to his house to eat and drink.
readings.support: I too am a prophet like you, and an angel spoke to me by the word of the LORD, saying, ‘Bring him back with you to your house, so that he may eat bread and drink water.’

readings.answer: To bring him back to his house so he may eat bread and drink water.
readings.support: ‘Bring him back with you to your house, so that he may eat bread and drink water.’

assessments.reason: It accurately restates the old prophet’s reply that “an angel spoke to me … ‘Bring him back … so that he may eat bread and drink water,’” matching the substance of the answer; it omits noting “The old prophet was lying to him,” which the key emphasizes but the question did not require.

It captures the core content of the purported message—“Bring him back … so that he may eat bread and drink water”—though it leaves out that he attributed it to an angel and that it was a lie; still a reasonable paraphrase of the answer’s content.
